output.answer: Bath & Body Works, Inc. is the parent company and corporate owner of the Bath & Body Works brand. The company’s latest annual report, filed March 12, 2026, identifies Bath & Body Works, Inc. as the company and describes it as selling products under the Bath & Body Works brand name.
caveats: “Parent company” can mean the legal owner of the brand or a higher-level corporate parent. The latest annual report supports Bath & Body Works, Inc. as the relevant corporate owner and does not identify a separate higher-level parent.
